author: m.kalinin
content:
> The 30 s engine timeout answers -32603 without cancelling the task, so a stale fork choice can be applied later.
> 
> Cancel the queued or running task when the response times out.

I am not sure it makes sense to cancel payload execution, it might even make things worse in the case when that payload is canonical and a node has to process it.

If after processing a stale `fcU` engine is still capable of processing  another `newPayload + fcU` from CL, processing the stale calls doesn't look too dangerous to me.

One thing that might be outdated in that case is the payload build process.

author: m.kalinin
content:
> Can return an empty payload as a success when the 800 ms build-wait expires.
> 
> Return an error or SYNCING rather than presenting an empty payload as a successful build.

I am not sure `SYNCING` should be used in all such cases. What is the exact cause of returning an empty payload? If the root cause is that a node is syncing then response to the `fcU` should be `SYNCING`, yes

author: m.kalinin
content:
> serialise fcU behind newPayload

Btw, this makes sense if `fcU` would have `head=P` while `newPayload` is processing that `P`. But that must not happen unless CL is buggy, CL must never send `fcU(head=P)` until it gets any response from `newPayload(P)`. So, *not serializing* these two makes sense.

And not serializing these two calls also withdraws a problem with the stale `fcU` call

author: nero_eth
content: you're right. this is then also a false positive, and if we accept that ELs trust their CL, then it's fine to do it one way or the other.

author: ahshum
content:
> Skips proposal preparation when the EL looks unhealthy — `node.isSynced(head) and head.executionValid` with a silent `else: nil`, no hysteresis.
It is in spec to skip proposal due to optimistic sync (<https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.4/specs/bellatrix/optimistic-sync.md>).
- <https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/issues/9203>
- <https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/9220>

Or when EL is unhealthy, proposal should build on EMPTY instead? It would require spec changes I believe.
